d: Before taking any loan, borrowers should shift their focus from eligibility to affordability and assess whether borrowing is truly necessary. A loan is not extra income but an advance on future earnings that carries interest, meaning a lower monthly EMI often masks a higher total repayment cost due to an extended tenure. To understand the true cost of borrowing, evaluate the Annual Percentage Rate (APR), which combines interest with processing fees and other charges into a single annualised figure.
